svg.aria-label: Top view of where a clock can sit around the BF-018A board
svg.title: Top view of where a clock can sit around the BF-018A board
svg.text: Where to put the clock: reach around the board
Top view, the clock's bar antenna parallel to the coil's axis (left-right here). The outline is the
farthest a clock syncs, for the clock BotanicFields measured in Japan (70 cm yes, 90 cm no, at 40 kHz).
dead zone (55° off axis): no signal
40 kHz: up to 79 cm in line
60 kHz: up to 64 cm in line (same clock threshold)
Grey bar in each clock: its ferrite-bar antenna. Turn a clock 90° and the in-line spots become the weak ones.
